description: The text of a US company's SEC filing as clean Markdown, for reading by an LLM: give a ticker, CIK or name and a form (10-K default, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, S-1, DEF 14A) for the latest one, or an accession number. Optional section returns one part only (risk-factors, business, mdna, legal, market-risk, financials, controls, or an item number). Tables become Markdown tables; lists the items found with offsets. SEC EDGAR public data. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

accession.description: A specific filing's accession number (0000320193-24-000123) instead of the latest

form.description: Form of the latest filing to read (default 10-K)

section.description: One part only: risk-factors, business, mdna, legal, market-risk, financials, controls, cybersecurity, or an item number (1A, 7)

name: sec_filing_text
